description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the orangehrmPimPlugin entity decorator namespace. It provides methods to enhance the EmployeeLicense entity with additional functionality such as setting related Employee and License entities by ID, and formatting license date fields for output.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds auxiliary functions to the EmployeeLicense entity, including setting related entities and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with an EmployeeLicense entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the license using the employee number.

methods.name: setLicenseByLicenseId
methods.description: Associates a License entity with the license using the license ID.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the license issued date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the license expiry date formatted as a string.
